trello_card.description:
## Powerhouse Capital - VC Outreach Packet

### Fund Overview
- **Fund Name:** Powerhouse Capital
- **Location:** Los Angeles, California
- **AUM:** Early-stage venture fund (exact AUM undisclosed, Fund I active)
- **Stage Focus:** Seed through Series A, with capacity for growth capital
- **Check Size:** $500K - $3M typical range

### Investment Thesis
Powerhouse Capital is exclusively dedicated to global technology investment opportunities in media, entertainment, sports & interactive gaming. They invest in direct-to-consumer platforms powered by data, with particular emphasis on:
- Visual content & interactive media
- Audio & music technology
- Gaming & esports
- Sports technology
- The experience economy

**AI/Gaming Infrastructure Alignment:** HIGH
- Recently invested in Lil Snack (AI-powered gaming company leveraging AI at the edge)
- Actively seeking intersections of Gaming & AI
- Focus on data-powered consumer platforms

### Key Partner: Salim Mitha
- **Title:** Co-Founder & Managing Partner
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/powerhousecapital
- **Email:** salim@powerhouse.vc (inferred)
- **Background:** Deep media & gaming investment experience

**Secondary Contact: Ian Doody**
- Partner at Powerhouse Capital, also involved in Lil Snack investment

### Notable Portfolio Companies
- **Lil Snack** - AI-powered interactive entertainment (recent $3.1M round lead)
- **Meco** - Application software / consumer platform
- **Toya** - Entertainment software / gaming
- **Arena** - Hardware / live experiences
- **MasterClass** - Media platform (exited)
- **Wondery** - Audio content (acquired by Amazon)
- **The Athletic** - Sports media (acquired by NY Times)
- **Epic!** - Children's digital media

### Recent Activity
- Most recent investment: Lil Snack (AI gaming company)
- Made 3 investments in 2024
- ~38 companies in portfolio over last 5 years

### Outreach Angle
**Primary Hook:** AI infrastructure for gaming - emphasize how our platform enables AI-powered game experiences at scale. Reference Lil Snack investment as proof of their AI+gaming interest.

**Secondary Hooks:**
1. Data-powered consumer platforms (core thesis match)
2. Gaming infrastructure that enables next-gen experiences
3. LA-based (local connection opportunity)

### Outreach Strategy
1. Warm intro through LA gaming ecosystem (strong LA network)
2. Reference Lil Snack announcement showing AI+gaming thesis alignment
3. Lead with AI infrastructure angle - not just gaming but AI-enabled gaming
4. Demo technical capabilities that align with data-powered platform thesis

### Resources
- Website: https://powerhouse.vc
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/powerhousecapital
- Portfolio: https://powerhouse.vc/about/
checklist: [ ] Research Salim Mitha background and recent talks/interviews
[ ] Find warm intro path through LA gaming network
[ ] Draft personalized outreach email referencing Lil Snack/AI thesis
[ ] Follow up within 5 days if no response
